title: Identity morphism
description: JSON Schema for an identity morphism — id_A : A → A, the do-nothing morphism on an object A (Mac Lane 1971 Ch. I §1). The neutral element for composition: f ∘ id_A = f and id_B ∘ f = f for every f : A → B. Every object has exactly one identity morphism; uniqueness follows from the unit law. Specializes transformer by pinning domain to equal codomain to the at-object; the equality is recorded as a single at-object cell rather than two separate domain/codomain cells.

at-object.description: The object A on which this identity morphism acts. The morphism's domain and codomain both equal this object.
